title: usenet-ipfs-mail: Mailbox support
description:
Implement JMAP Mailbox objects backed by newsgroups: Mailbox/get, Mailbox/query, Mailbox/changes (stub), and per-user subscription tracking in SQLite. Each newsgroup maps to one Mailbox; id is a stable hash of the group name.

Why: JMAP clients need to enumerate mailboxes before querying emails; subscriptions let users choose which groups to track.

How to apply: Email methods depend on Mailbox ids being resolvable.
